description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 white Spirit creature token
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat
